newsitem.title: USA: U.S. NE heating demand above normal this week - WSC.
newsitem.headline: U.S. NE heating demand above normal this week - WSC.

text.p: Energy usage for heating in the U.S. northeast will average above to much above normal through to Sunday with the coldest weather for the season to date expected, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
Temperatures will drop to 6-12 degrees Fahrenheit below normal on Thursday and 8-16 below on Friday, before moderating to 5-10 below on Saturday and 2-4 below on Sunday.
Energy usage for heating in northwest Europe will average above normal during the next 3-5 days, WSC added.
